text:
answer the follwoing questions with an eye towrds digital forensics: Report Writing for High-Tech Investigations
   
  Flag question: Question 1
  Question 11 pts
  Besides presenting facts, reports can communicate expert opinion.
  Group of answer choices
  
  False
  
  True
   
  Flag question: Question 2
  Question 21 pts
  A verbal report is more structured than a written report.
  Group of answer choices
  
  True
  
  False
   
  Flag question: Question 3
  Question 31 pts
  If you must write a preliminary report, use words such as “preliminary copy,”“draft copy,” or “working draft.”
  Group of answer choices
  
  False
  
  True
   
  Flag question: Question 4
  Question 41 pts
  As with any research paper, write the report abstract last.
  Group of answer choices
  
  True
  
  False
   
  Flag question: Question 5
  Question 51 pts
  When writing a report, use a formal, technical style.
  Group of answer choices
  
  False
  
  True
   
  Flag question: Question 6
  Question 61 pts
  Attorneys can now submit documents electronically in many courts; the standard format in U.S. federal courts is ____.
  Group of answer choices
  
  Postscript (PS)
  
  Portable Document Format (PDF)
  
  Encapsulated Postscript (EPS)
  
  Microsoft Word (DOC)
   
  Flag question: Question 7
  Question 71 pts
  A(n) ____ is a document that serves as a guideline for knowing what questions to expect when you are testifying.
  Group of answer choices
  
  written report
  
  subpoena
  
  affidavit
  
  examination plan
   
  Flag question: Question 8
  Question 81 pts
  You can use the ____ to help your attorney learn the terms and functions used in digital forensics.
  Group of answer choices
  
  preliminary report
  
  verbal report
  
  examination plan
  
  final report
   
  Flag question: Question 9
  Question 91 pts
  A written report is frequently a(n) ____ or a declaration.
  Group of answer choices
  
  deposition
  
  subpoena
  
  affidavit
  
  perjury
   
  Flag question: Question 10
  Question 101 pts
  If a report is long and complex, you should provide a(n) ____.
  Group of answer choices
  
  abstract
  
  table of contents
  
  glossary
  
  appendix
   
  Flag question: Question 11
  Question 111 pts
  A(n) ____ is sworn to under oath (and penalty of perjury or comparable false swearing statute).
  Group of answer choices
  
  cross-examination report
  
  written report
  
  examination plan
  
  verbal report
   
  Flag question: Question 12
  Question 121 pts
  The method for expressing an opinion is to have an attorney frame a ____ question based on available factual evidence.
  Group of answer choices
  
  hypothetical
  
  contradictory
  
  nested
  
  challenging
   
  Flag question: Question 13
  Question 131 pts
  An expert’s opinion is governed by FRE, Rule ____, and the corresponding rule in many states.
  Group of answer choices
  
  755
  
  805
  
  855
  
  705
   
  Flag question: Question 14
  Question 141 pts
  Remember that anything you write down as part of your examination for a report in a civil litigation case is subject to ____ from the opposing attorney.
  Group of answer choices
  
  deposition
  
  discovery
  
  subpoena
  
  publishing
   
  Flag question: Question 15
  Question 151 pts
  A written preliminary report is considered a ____ document because opposing counsel can demand discovery on it.
  Group of answer choices
  
  no-risk
  
  low-risk
  
  middle-risk
  
  high-risk
   
  Flag question: Question 16
  Question 161 pts
  The abstract should be one or two paragraphs totaling about 150 to ____ words.
  Group of answer choices
  
  350
  
  250
  
  300
  
  200
   
  Flag question: Question 17
  Question 171 pts
  ____ provide additional resource material not included in the body of the report.
  Group of answer choices
  
  Conclusion
  
  References
  
  Discussion
  
  Appendixes
   
  Flag question: Question 18
  Question 181 pts
  Typically, report writers use one of two numbering systems: decimal numbering or ____ numbering.
  Group of answer choices
  
  letter-sequential
  
  legal-sequential
  
  roman-sequential
  
  arabic-sequential
   
  Flag question: Question 19
  Question 191 pts
  A report using the ____ numbering system divides material into sections and restarts numbering with each main section.
  Group of answer choices
  
  legal-sequential
  
  decimal
  
  indent
  
  roman-sequential
   
  Flag question: Question 20
  Question 201 pts
  In the main section of your report, you typically cite references with the ____ enclosed in parentheses.
  Group of answer choices
  
  year of publication
  
  author’s last name and year of publication
  
  author’s last name
  
  year of publication and author’s last name
   
  Flag question: Question 21
  Question 211 pts
  Save broader generalizations and summaries for the report’s ____.
  Group of answer choices
  
  conclusion
  
  introduction
  
  appendixes
  
  discussion
   
  Flag question: Question 22
  Question 221 pts
  The report’s ____ should restate the objectives, aims, and key questions and summarize your findings with clear, concise statements.
  Group of answer choices
  
  introduction
  
  abstract
  
  reference
  
  conclusion
   
  Flag question: Question 23
  Question 231 pts
  If necessary, you can include ____ containing material such as raw data, figures not used in the body of the report, and anticipated exhibits.
  Group of answer choices
  
  appendixes
  
  references
  
  discussions
  
  conclusions
   
  Flag question: Question 24
  Question 241 pts
  Reports and logs generated by forensic tools are typically in text format, word processing, spreadsheet, or ____ format.
  Group of answer choices
  
  PDF
  
  PS
  
  TXT
  
  HTML
   
  Flag question: Question 25
  Question 251 pts
  The report body consists of the introduction and ____ sections.
  Group of answer choices
  
  discussion
  
  abstract
  
  appendixes
  
  conclusion
   
  Flag question: Question 26
  Question 261 pts
  Match each item with a statement below
  Group of answer choices
  Draw reader’s attention to a point in your report.
  
  [ Choose ]
  A report numbering system
  
  [ Choose ]
  Used by an attorney to guide an expert witness in his or her testimony
  
  [ Choose ]
  A forensics software tool
  
  [ Choose ]
  Lawyers jargon for destroying or concealing evidence
  
  [ Choose ]
  Stands for Message Digest 5
  
  [ Choose ]
  Typically takes place in an attorney’s office where the attorney requests your consultant’s report
  
  [ Choose ]
  Starts by referring to the report’s purpose, states the main points, draws conclusions, and possibly renders an opinion
  
  [ Choose ]
  A witness testifying to personally observed facts
  
  [ Choose ]
  Considered additional material on a report and might not be examined by readers 
  
  [ Choose ]
   
  Flag question: Question 27
  Question 271 pts
  When writing a report, style means the tone of language you use to address the reader.
  Group of answer choices
  
  True
  
  False
   
  Flag question: Question 28
  Question 281 pts
  The decimal numbering system is frequently used when writing pleadings.
  Group of answer choices
  
  False
  
  True
   
  Flag question: Question 29
  Question 291 pts
  Lawyers use services called deposition banks (libraries), which store examples of expert witnesses’ previous testimony.
  Group of answer choices
  
  False
  
  True
   
  Flag question: Question 30
  Question 301 pts
  Signposts assist readers in scanning the text quickly by highlighting the main points and logical development of information.
  Group of answer choices
  
  True
  
  False
   
  Flag question: Question 31
  Question 311 pts
  For civil cases, including those involving digital forensics investigations, U.S. district courts consider optional that expert witnesses submit written reports.
  Group of answer choices
  
  True
  
  False
